name: io.github.dolevhayut/winglet
description: Edit the content of a Next.js site without running an agent. List, read, create, update and publish pages, posts and products in a hosted CMS built for sites that coding agents produced.

environmentVariables.name: WINGLET_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the content API. Defaults to the hosted one.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <project write key>. Printed by the CLI during setup and shown in the studio.
